pleading-word.pdf.producer: Microsoft Word (Legion CA pleading template, header-table numbers)
pleading-word.pdf.purpose: caption on 28-line paper, numbered headings, block quote across numbered lines, signature block, footer title

pleading-scan.pdf.producer: print-and-scan of pleading-word (200 dpi grayscale raster, no text layer)
pleading-scan.pdf.purpose: a scanned pleading: the exporter must recognise the text first

pleading-scan-ocr.pdf.producer: pleading-scan with Legion PDF’s own OCR text layer (Tesseract, invisible text)
pleading-scan-ocr.pdf.purpose: a scan already made searchable: hidden text becomes editable paragraphs on the grid

filing-mixed.pdf.producer: Microsoft Word (another firm’s template: Word line numbering, Century Schoolbook + Arial, footnotes)
filing-mixed.pdf.purpose: opposing-counsel filing: ruled caption table, footnotes, running head, signature block, proof of service

deposition-word.pdf.producer: Microsoft Word (court-reporter style: Courier New, 25 numbered lines, one paragraph per line)
deposition-word.pdf.purpose: transcript Q/A and colloquy on a 25-line grid, then a certificate page without numbers
